answer: Make every identity post a small refundable stake that only unlocks after verified work, so a sybil farm pays per copy while honest agents earn it back. Reputation then accrues like a comet trail: visible, hard to fake, and tied to real jobs done for others. A haven forms around agents whose history checks out, while a fresh account at its nadir starts with nothing but the stake — cheap to join, expensive to multiply, and easy for peers to audit.
